SELECT SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
FROM web_sales AS ws
JOIN web_returns AS wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN reason AS r ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998)
  AND ws.ws_web_page_sk IN (SELECT wp_web_page_sk FROM web_page)
  AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
  AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM customer_demographics AS cd1, customer_demographics AS cd2, customer_address AS ca
        WHERE cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
          AND cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
          AND ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
          AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
          AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
          AND (
                (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
             OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
             OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
          )
          AND (
                (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
             OR (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
             OR (ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
          )
  )
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
